children: The Kuwait-listed Al Ajial Real Estate Entertainment Company (AREC) has renewed and increased its loan facility with an Islamic bank to a value of 56 million dinars ($181 million).
The real estate developer, which operates cinemas and entertainment facilities in Kuwait, said the capital will fund its core activities.
AREC said the financial impact of the loan will depend on its utilisation and repayment.
(Writing by Bindu Rai, editing by Daniel Luiz)

title: Kuwait-listed AREC renews, increases loan facility to $181mln
